justification: Inspected src/main/java/org/apache/commons/io/input/BoundedReader.java and src/test/java/org/apache/commons/io/input/BoundedReaderTest.java. The class is a small, single-purpose Reader wrapper: 1 constructor and 5 overrides (close, mark, read, read(char[],int,int), reset) across 151 lines, with one target collaborator and state only for enforcing a character limit and mark/reset boundary. The test class exercises only that bounded-read behavior. There is no evidence of multiple responsibilities, broad public API surface, or separable cohesive groups that would indicate insufficient modularization.
